title: Add Structured Request Logging Middleware with Correlation ID
description: Introduce a lightweight middleware that generates a unique request ID, logs inbound request details (method, path, headers) and outbound response data (status, duration). This improves observability, aids debugging, and aligns with production monitoring requirements without adding dependencies.
testCases: Verify that each incoming request receives a unique `X-Request-Id` header and that the same ID appears in the log output
Confirm that the middleware logs method, url, status code, and response time with correct formatting and without throwing errors for edge cases (e.g., missing headers)
acceptance: All tests pass; logs contain the request ID, method, url, status, and duration; `X-Request-Id` header is present on responses; no performance regression detected in benchmark suite
reason: Production teams need reliable request tracing for debugging and compliance. Adding built‑in structured logging eliminates the need for external packages, keeps the framework zero‑dependency, and enhances error investigation while maintaining the lightweight ethos of yantraverse.
